body: As I gaze out the window, the drone seems to hover in an unnerving pattern, refusing to budge. I notice the sunlight dancing across its metallic surface, and my blood starts to simmer. I think about the countless hours I've spent inside this office, the meetings, the deadlines, the endless cubicle walls. It's as if it's mocking me, daring me to do something.
